concerns.text: FR-001 mandates 'download and parse' from NIST/OpenKIM. Tasks T006b and T006a implement a 'manual curation' strategy (hardcoded JSON) which contradicts the spec requirement. There is no task to implement the download/parsing logic mandated by FR-001, nor is there a task to formally update FR-001 in the spec to reflect the manual curation reality before implementation proceeds.

FR-008 mandates R² ≥ 0.99. Task T016 implements R² ≥ 0.95 (citing Constitution). While T008a drafts a PR to update the spec, the task itself is marked 'REJECTED' in the analyze report, and no task exists to *execute* the spec update or to implement the logic for the 0.99 threshold if the spec were to remain unchanged. The implementation assumes a spec change that is not yet ratified in the artifact being covered.

SC-005 mandates a 'bootstrap difference-of-means test (p ≤ 0.05)'. Task T027 implements 'descriptive trend analysis' instead. There is no task to implement the p-value test required by SC-005, nor a ratified task to update SC-005 in the spec. The implementation diverges from the acceptance criteria defined in the spec.

SC-003 contains placeholder '[deferred]' for sensitivity parameters. Task T021 hardcodes {0.1, 0.2, 0.3}. While the Plan defines these values, there is no task to update SC-003 in the spec to remove the placeholders and ratify these values as the official acceptance criteria. The task relies on an external plan decision not yet reflected in the spec.

Task T008a is listed as 'REJECTED' in the analyze report context, yet it is the only task addressing the spec contradictions. If the spec remains contradictory, the implementation lacks a valid basis. The task list should reflect the status of this critical alignment task or include a fallback task to proceed with the Plan's values as the de facto spec.
